layerRequirements.positiveEvidence: Bound AP2/FIDO/Verifiable Intent mandate with principal, spender, payee, purpose, rail, cap, expiry, revocation, and audit reference.
Protected-resource authorization for the exact service/tool/resource scope.
x402/payment challenge, payload, selected rail, response, and facilitator verification references.
Environment, mint, program, payer, payee, amount, signature, and confirmation proof against allowlists.
Service result hash, status, completed-at timestamp, and resource response reference.
Required evaluator gate result for service quality and policy acceptance.
Unique receipt id, request hash, idempotency key, nonce, and duplicate-payment rejection.
Privacy-minimized accounting refs that can join receipt, payment, settlement, service, and eval evidence.
Closed/clear dispute state before final acceptance or reputation emission.
No rollback, hold, kill-switch, or refund/retry criteria active.

nextIssue.title: Add static Pay.sh/x402 discovery compatibility report

receiptIntegrityRule: RAP acceptance requires all layers to pass; x402/payment settlement alone cannot become service success, delegated authority, reputation eligibility, dispute closure, or accounting acceptance.

threatCases.proves: RAP can accept only when payment, authority, resource access, settlement, service, eval, replay, accounting, dispute, and rollback evidence all pass.

diagnostics.remediation: Bind settled payment to a concrete service result before accounting or reputation.

threatCases.proves: Payment evidence alone cannot become service success.
threatCases.threat: x402 settlement is present but service result is missing

diagnostics.remediation: Require mandate purpose, spender, payee, cap, and expiry to match the receipt.

threatCases.proves: A real authorization cannot be reused outside its bounded intent.
threatCases.threat: valid mandate is reused for the wrong purpose

diagnostics.remediation: Bind principal, spender, payee, purpose, rail, cap, expiry, and audit reference.

threatCases.proves: Delegated authority must be stronger than a generic payment permission.
threatCases.threat: mandate exists but does not bind payee and cap

diagnostics.remediation: Persist privacy-safe request, response, payment, settlement, service, and eval references.

threatCases.proves: Receipt integrity needs accountable joins, not standalone payment records.
threatCases.threat: accounting cannot link request, response, payment, and evaluator

diagnostics.remediation: Reject duplicate payment response hashes and require stable idempotency keys.

threatCases.proves: A settled payment cannot be counted twice.
threatCases.threat: same payment response is replayed under a duplicate receipt

diagnostics.remediation: Reject receipts whose mandate expiry or revocation state is stale.

threatCases.proves: Payment success after expiry cannot revive stale delegated authority.
threatCases.threat: authorization scope expired before receipt finalization

diagnostics.remediation: Match protected resource metadata and tool scope to the paid service receipt.

threatCases.proves: Protected resource access stays separate from payment permission.
threatCases.threat: MCP/resource authorization covers a different resource

diagnostics.remediation: Require authority payee, x402 accepts entry, and settlement destination to match.

threatCases.proves: Settlement proof must bind to the intended payee or merchant.
threatCases.threat: settlement payee differs from mandate and service merchant

diagnostics.remediation: Hold accounting and reputation; route the receipt to refund, retry, or dispute handling.

threatCases.proves: Settled payment with failed service is not a successful RAP receipt.

diagnostics.remediation: Attach x402/payment evidence before paid-service accounting can pass.

threatCases.proves: Service success alone cannot create payment accounting evidence.
threatCases.threat: service succeeded but payment evidence is absent

diagnostics.remediation: Block reputation and acceptance until required evaluation gates pass.

threatCases.proves: Reputation eligibility requires evaluation evidence, not just payment and service completion.
threatCases.threat: service result is present but required evaluator failed

diagnostics.remediation: Hold final accounting and reputation until dispute resolution closes.

threatCases.proves: Disputed receipts cannot close accounting or reputation.

diagnostics.remediation: Preserve hold evidence and block acceptance while rollback criteria are active.

threatCases.proves: Operational rollback or kill-switch state overrides payment settlement.
threatCases.threat: rollback or kill-switch criteria are active
